title: no3in-archive: reproducible data and verification for the no-three-in-line census
description: Code and data archive accompanying the paper 'Cycle structure and the Hamming geometry of no-three-in-line solutions'. Pins the exact snapshot of Flammenkamp's no-three-in-line database (revision 2026-08-11, SHA-256 6c385257c34af354a596b718002e2ef552b52da54b8e5065ec6a8b8c4d5026e0), recomputes every [DB-Exh] claim with two independent code paths, and provides derived tables (CSV/JSON), a one-command reproduction script, machine-readable verification outputs, and Section 8 solver-study materials with explicit exhaustive/incomplete run statuses. The raw database itself is not redistributed (no explicit licence); the download recipe and digest pin are included instead. Python 3.9+, standard library only for the main pipeline.
